{{Top|leg}}
A '''ritualist''' was a member of an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] group on the [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] who performed certain arcane duties. The [[Gondula]] and [[Panshee]] tribes employed individuals of this vocation, as did nomadic Ewok tribes known as [[Jinda/Legends|Jindas]].<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide]]''</ref>
